newsitem.title: USA: Intelligent Systems Corp Q4 net increases.
newsitem.headline: Intelligent Systems Corp Q4 net increases.

text.p: NOTE: The company said 1996 results do not include the results of ISJ subsidiary sold in December 1995.
Net income for the fourth quarter of 1996 includes a gain of $3.0 million on sale of IQ Software stock and a reserve of $1.0 million to reduce the carrying value of another investment.
Net income for the fourth quarter of 1995 includes a gain of $1.3 million on the sale of the ISJ subsidiary.

Net income for fiscal year 1996 includes a gain of $337,000 on the sale of stock in OrCAD IPO, $6.6 million on the sales of IQ Software stock and a charge of $1.0 million to reduce the carrying value of another investment.
Net income for fiscal year 1995 includes a gain of $1.3 million on the sale of the ISJ subsidiary and a gain of $818,000 on the sale of IQ Software stock.
